label: GO step near the end of the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (never D1 or D2). Activation is concentrated at the end of the episode: 80% of activation mass falls in episode trials 90-99 (rate 29% there vs about 1% in trials 20-69), with a small bump in the first few trials. Equivalently it tracks a low value-head output (82% of mass at value < 5.22, none at value > 8.1), because the remaining return falls as the episode nears its end. Magnitude rises toward the episode end (the top quartile is about 99% covered by ep_trial >= 85, the bottom quartile only 32%). Within a phase it is mildly higher after an unrewarded previous trial (rate 7.9% vs 3.4%) and on a1 choices. Choice/state/transition/reward content barely matters. It is a phase x time-in-episode (episode-clock / low-value) unit. ep_trial >= 85 and value < 6 score about the same (dev F1 0.68-0.69, mass recall 0.89); the ep_trial version is recorded because it is simpler. Missed activations are weak GO firings earlier in the episode. Uses no future variables.
